in_marathi.name: Khushal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khushal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Persian word 'Khushal' meaning 'joy', 'happiness', and 'prosperity'. This name was popularized in India and became a common name among Hindus.
